name: agentic-finance-function
description: Turn finance exports into a governed close review, variance analysis, and decision brief with explicit evidence and human approval boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Review finance work with evidence, controls, and explicit exceptions.
interface.longDescription: Apply the Agentic Finance Function governance model to a close, variance analysis, management pack, reforecast, or finance-function assessment. The plugin keeps observed facts, calculations, and hypotheses separate and leaves approval with the finance owner.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review these finance files. Start with a data-readiness verdict, identify any definition decisions, and produce a traceable executive brief with owned exceptions.
